title: chat-server: opt-in conditional
description:
Design: docs/design/conditional.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: C9a. Crates: jmap-chat-server. Size: L.

Apply the C7 pattern to jmap-chat-server (docs/design/conditional.md §5.1, §6, §7; decision 1 in docs/design/DECISIONS.md). Add register_chat_conditional attaching SetSupport to every registered chat /set; register_chat_handlers unchanged. Memory backend on ScopedState (outbound/side-effect queues in Inner so rollback drops them), ConditionalBackend impl; Atomic final-state checks: CustomEmoji/SpaceBan uniqueness, overQuota and per-account caps; defer outbound federation to commit. Also test PushSubscription/set conditional on chat memory via register_push_subscription_conditional (C5). Acceptance: one precondition test, one atomic rollback test on the main type, one final-state quota/cap test, push precondition on keys -> forbidden; conditional_ready() after opt-in; existing tests unchanged; public-api additions only.
